# Error codes

Every code below was read from the crates' source, not typed by hand
(FR-003, AC-005). A published code keeps its meaning for the life of the
crate and is never reused for a different failure (CON-205); the upgrade
policy in [Upgrading](upgrading.md) explains what that means across
versions.

The scan reads `crates/*/src/**/*.rs` up to each file's first
`#[cfg(test)]` module, and collects four shapes:

- `pub const CODE_X: &str = "W2004";` — meaning from the doc comment above
  the constant.
- `#[error("QL-EXCEEDED: ...")]` — meaning from the rendered message.
- `Self::Variant => "PC-AUTH",` — meaning from the doc comment on the enum
  variant.
- `.error("D1003", "anchors are not supported")` — meaning from the message
  literal at the call site.

Where one code is raised from several places, every distinct message is
listed, in source order. Regenerate with `node scripts/docs-errors.js`;
`node scripts/docs-check.js` fails when this page is stale.
